# A single branch accepts a message file without a branch prefix.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T18:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add feature.txt
gs branch create feature -m 'Default title' -m 'Default body'
gs --no-prompt branch submit --no-draft --message-file $WORK/message.md
stderr 'Created #1'

# An existing CR validates the path without reading or changing its message.
gs --no-prompt branch submit --no-draft --message-file $WORK/empty.md
shamhub dump changes
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/changes.json

-- repo/feature.txt --
Feature contents
-- message.md --
Supplied title

Supplied body.
-- empty.md --

-- golden/changes.json --
[
  {
    "number": 1,
    "html_url": "$SHAMHUB_URL/alice/example/change/1",
    "state": "open",
    "title": "Supplied title",
    "body": "Supplied body.",
    "base": {
      "repository": {
        "owner": "alice",
        "name": "example"
      },
      "ref": "main",
      "sha": "916aa67db81180eaa7caedbebc50e8edb234c4ae"
    },
    "head": {
      "repository": {
        "owner": "alice",
        "name": "example"
      },
      "ref": "feature",
      "sha": "d068acee358bfcbd342c2f6e9dcd454e498d5948"
    }
  }
]
